summary: A reporter explains the deadline when asking a member to speak on the record.
realLife: Milwaukee station FOX6 told Governor Tony Evers’s office it was preparing a story about access to his emails. The office asked what the story would cover, and the station’s deadline passed without a statement.
inGame: needs: a story deadline available to the press interview.
gates: The story has a recorded deadline.

turns.what: The reporter calls back after the deadline moves.
turns.pulledBy: The editor has held the story for the next edition.
turns.writesBack: The member receives a new comment deadline.

turns.what: The office sends the date it received the request before airtime and promises a decision the following morning.
turns.pulledBy: The clerk can verify the intake stamp, while the official responsible for releasing records has yet to reply.
turns.writesBack: The evening report gives the receipt date and the assignment desk puts the promised answer on tomorrow’s list.
